config_name: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra — Dimensity 9400+, 12GB RAM, 256GB, 14.6" Dynamic AMOLED 2X 120Hz + Book Cover Keyboard Slim S11/S12 Ultra (price includes Slim cover; Pro Keyboard w/ trackpad option noted).

specs.storage_type: UFS soldered + dedicated microSDXC slot (up to 2TB)
specs.speakers: Quad AKG-tuned speakers (larger chambers than S11)
specs.keyboard_notes: Book Cover Keyboard Slim S11/S12 Ultra included in price ($299.99 reg cover): scissor keys + AI key, NO trackpad. Pro Keyboard with trackpad $499.99 reg/$299.99 sale (BBY 20142500) is the premium typing option
specs.pen_support: S Pen INCLUDED in box (Bluetooth air actions, 4096 pressure, IP68)
specs.os: Android 16 / One UI 8 at launch (Android 17 / One UI 9 current); 7 years OS+security updates

battery.notes: 11600 mAh (~44.4Wh) cell, 45W USB-PD charging (charger not in box). No official video-hours claim; users report ~8-11h mixed real-world use on the 14.6" panel.

price.notes: Bundle price = tablet (current best new retail) + keyboard, per the config definition. Components: Tablet $1,749.99 reg / $1,499.99 sale (BBY SKU 19627589) + Book Cover Keyboard Slim Ultra $299.99 reg / $179.99 sale (BBY 19433657) = $2,049.98 at regular prices. Cover-only price: Slim $299.99 reg/$179.99 sale; Pro Keyboard w/ trackpad $499.99/$299.99 (BBY 20142500) — pairing with Pro Keyboard totals ~$2,249.98 reg.     BBY sale combined total ~$1,679.98. 5G variant omitted.

offers.name: Bundle: tablet + keyboard (config price includes the keyboard). Tablet listing 1499 + keyboard per price.notes.

reviews.quote: One of the most capable Android tablets you can buy.
A disappointing chipset lets down an otherwise fantastic media and gaming machine.
Totally ridiculous, but that hasn't stopped me liking it.

praises: 14.6" AMOLED at 5.1mm thin — the biggest tablet screen you can still pick up with one hand-ish, and MacBook-sized when opened on a tray table
S Pen in the box — no extra $199 accessory tax like the iPad Pro; magnetically charges on the back edge
DeX on 14.6" is the best desktop-mode screen Samsung makes: three or four free-form windows genuinely fit
Full Galaxy phone continuity: Quick Share, common clipboard, calls/texts on the tablet — Apple-continuity-grade within the family
microSDXC slot still present — a 2TB card beats Samsung's soldered storage upsell
complaints: The Slim cover priced in here has NO trackpad — the trackpad keyboard is the $499.99 Pro Keyboard, a real extra
Android tablet app optimization still lags the hardware: several popular apps are stretched phone UIs on 14.6" 120Hz
No 3.5mm headphone jack; USB-C audio needs a dongle
At full regular price the Ultra + keyboard approaches MacBook Pro money while still running Android apps

design_philosophy: The Ultra is Samsung's 'biggest screen we can make thin' statement: a 14.6" AMOLED thinner than most ultrabook lids, aimed squarely at people who want an iPad Pro 13 alternative without Apple's accessory pricing. DeX is the flagship experience here — the 14.6" panel is where Android desktop mode finally looks like a desktop. This 12/256 tier is the entry point to that screen; the keyboard cover is priced in per this dataset's rule, exposing the trackpad gap that the Pro Keyboard exists to fill.
rating_notes: Pro scores from What Hi-Fi/TechRadar/Android Police Tab S11 Ultra reviews (gap-fill 2026-11-25). Ratings inferred from the Tab S11 11" 12/256 anchor per SHARED-tab-s11.md cross-config note: screen_size 5.8→8.2, portability 9.2→7.6 (692g but 5.1mm), battery +0.4 (11600 vs 8400 mAh), productivity +0.7 (DeX on 14.6" real estate), creative_work +0.5, gaming −0.2 (higher res), keyboard_trackpad 6.5 = Slim cover w/o trackpad but better keys/size; with the $499.99 Pro Keyboard (trackpad) it would be ~7.0. Ecosystem 7.0 = DeX + Galaxy-phone parity per SHARED calibration. Brightness figures are Samsung marketing approximations. User sentiment is disclosed synthesis, not verbatim quotes.
standouts: Largest AMOLED tablet display in current retail, at 5.1mm thin
Best-in-class DeX desktop canvas — 14.6" fits real multi-window work
dealbreakers: Trackpad only via the $499.99 Pro Keyboard — the priced-in Slim cover leaves you mouse-dependent
